_readme: Explicit additions layered on top of the generated schema.
The generated section is a faithful transcription of the specification's 823
field contracts. Everything here is a deliberate addition — either an
India-specific requirement the jurisdiction-neutral spec leaves open, or a
constraint §14 mandates in prose but the field list cannot express.
Each entry carries a `why` so a reviewer can challenge it.

Event.why: GAP-IN-09. Indian school editions are labelled '2026-27' because the academic year spans June–April. The spec's edition label is free text; validated against ACADEMIC_YEAR_RE.
GAP-IN-11. §1 lists Gujarati/Hindi/English as OPTIONAL. For a Sanand event Gujarati is the working language, so it is the default rather than an opt-in.

School.why: GAP-IN-05. §1 requires names retain their original script. Holds the Gujarati/Devanagari school name.

GAP-IN-02. The 11-digit UDISE+ code issued by the Ministry of Education. Makes the school master reconcilable with government data and survives renames. Optional: some private unaided schools cannot supply it at registration, and blocking on it is worse than missing it.
GAP-IN-01. ISO 3166-2:IN subdivision code. Needed once an event spans more than one district.
GAP-IN-01. India's operational hierarchy is State → District → Taluka → City/Village. Sanand is a taluka of Ahmedabad district; without this level the catchment cannot be expressed.
GAP-IN-01. The only machine-checkable locality key in an Indian address.
GAP-IN-02. Affiliation (GSEB/CBSE/…) determines how standards map to age bands.
GAP-IN-02. Government and municipal schools route approvals through the education department; private unaided do not. Operationally significant for CH assignment.
GAP-IN-02. Drives the default UI language for that school's staff and the language of printed start lists.

Athlete.why: GAP-IN-05. The child's name in Gujarati/Devanagari as the school register writes it.
GAP-IN-05. Optional component for sorting only. Never required — a meaningful minority of Indian names are single-token, and forcing a surname produces junk.
GAP-IN-05. As above; optional by design.

AthleteRegistration.why: GAP-IN-03. India's school unit is the Standard (1–12), not a US grade. Lives on the registration, not the athlete, because a child's class changes each edition. §5 requires class stay separate from age.
GAP-IN-03. Division within a standard ('A', 'B'). Used to locate a child on the school register during verification.

Category.why: GAP-IN-08. A competition is (age band × participation category). §5 forbids inferring this from names or photos, so it is declared explicitly.
GAP-IN-08. Expresses an 'Under-14' band directly, so the cutoff rule is auditable rather than only implied by dob_min/dob_max.

Document.why: GAP-IN-06. The spec's document_type is free text. A closed vocabulary lets the service refuse retention of the types that must not be kept.
GAP-IN-06/07. §13 requires retention policy to distinguish operational results from personal documents. An explicit expiry makes the purge job possible and auditable.
GAP-IN-06. Where an auditor must reconcile one record, only the last four digits are held. The full identity number is never stored — see docs/INDIA_DATA_MODEL.md.

VolunteerProfile.why: GAP-IN-11. The existing `language` column is free text; this is the closed vocabulary the UI actually switches on.
GAP-IN-04. Normalised +91XXXXXXXXXX for staff contact. Unique only where the login-identifier policy says so — never on athletes.

KitEntitlement.why: §9 requires optional kit items that never make a kit Partial (AT-023). Encoding 'optional' as required_quantity = 0 would overload a quantity to mean 'not applicable' — precisely what §1 forbids ('A missing value is not equivalent to zero, absent, invalid or not applicable'). An explicit flag also lets an optional item carry a real quantity, e.g. up to 2 caps on request.

field_overrides._why: Where the generated type is too loose to enforce a rule the spec states in prose.

Document.document_type.line: document_type                      String   /// Legacy free-text label; document_type_code is authoritative
Document.document_type.why: Kept for import compatibility, superseded by the closed vocabulary.

extra_back_relations._why: Back-relation fields the overlay models require on generated models. Prisma needs both sides declared.
